business_summary: Ichigo Hotel REIT Investment Corporation (hereinafter referred to as Ichigo Investment Corporation). Based on the Act (Act No. 198 of 1950, including subsequent amendments, hereinafter referred to as the Investment Trust Law), Ichigo (Act No. 198 of 1951, as amended; the Investment Trust Act), with Ichigo Investment Advisors Co., Ltd. Established as a sponsor on July 22, 2015 (investment amount: 300 million yen, number of shares issued: 3,000), and issued shares on November 30 of the same year. The Company will be listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (hereinafter referred to as the Tokyo Stock Exchange) Real Estate Investment Trust Securities Market. Ichigo Hotel REIT Investment Corporation was incorporated in 2015 in Japan.
business_summary_ko: 이치고호텔리츠투자주식회사(이하 이치고투자주식회사)입니다. 이치고(1951년 법률 제198호, 개정된 투자신탁법)에 의거하여 2015년 7월 22일 이치고투자자문주식회사를 후원자로 설립(투자금액: 3억엔, 발행주식수: 3,000주), 그리고 같은 해 11월 30일에 주식을 발행했습니다. 당사는 도쿄증권거래소(이하 도쿄증권거래소) 부동산투자신탁증권시장에 상장됩니다. Ichigo Hotel REIT Investment Corporation은 2015년 일본에서 설립되었습니다.
